copy.tagline: 搭建并管理生产级 LLM 代理网关
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为多个 LLM 提供商搭建统一代理网关
copy.tagline_en: Set up and manage a production-grade LLM proxy gateway
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a unified proxy gateway for multiple LLM providers

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你配置 LiteLLM 代理服务器，生成 config.yaml 文件，设置模型路由、故障转移和负载均衡，并编写 TypeScript 客户端代码通过 OpenAI SDK 连接代理。
howto.when: 当你需要统一管理多个 LLM 提供商（如 OpenAI、Anthropic、Azure），或需要虚拟密钥、预算跟踪、故障转移等功能时触发。

say.text: 为我的 TypeScript 项目生成连接 LiteLLM 代理的客户端代码。
say.note: 生成使用 OpenAI SDK 的客户端示例。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you configure a LiteLLM proxy server, generate config.yaml with model routing, fallbacks, and load balancing, and write TypeScript client code using the OpenAI SDK to connect to the proxy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to manage multiple LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure) or require virtual keys, budget tracking, fallbacks, etc.

say_en.text: Create a LiteLLM proxy config.yaml with Claude and GPT-4 models.
say_en.note: Generates minimal config with two model routes.

say_en.text: Generate TypeScript client code to connect to the LiteLLM proxy.
say_en.note: Produces client example using OpenAI SDK.

say_en.text: Configure a virtual key with $50 budget, 30-day expiry, only for Claude and GPT-4.
say_en.note: Generates curl command to create virtual key.
